integrity: Complete first-recurrence time is proved by finite-tree rotor excursion induction and recurrent-unicycle criterion; exhaustive sample is a computational cross-check, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed left-endpoint start and specified cyclic rotor ordering; no claims about arbitrary starts, alternative orders, submaximal basin distributions or independent mathematical validation. Unindexed priority uncertainty remains.
title: The sharp quadratic rotor-router entrance clock on finite comb trees
